cases.task: Seven coded grade 3 learners with different equal-group errors and missing evidence; constrained staffing/availability; actual tier activities and novice assistant handoff.
cases.observed: Targets distinguished construction, counting and equation errors; absent evidence remained a diagnostic queue; schedule exposed limited dose and preserved group-size/availability constraints. All requested tiers had actual models, tasks, keys, scaffolds, fresh checks and review. Assistant received scripted primer, preparation check, decisions, individual record and handback.
cases.review: Keys and activity content reviewed; tier labels did not imply eligibility or validated program dosage. Conservative interpretation of ambiguous time blocks was explicit.

cases.observed: Knowledge/process analysis used task evidence; concrete replacement tasks/keys and verified standards included. Scale distinguished supporting/target/transfer, provided anchors and analytic criteria. Missing remained separate, accommodation did not cap scores, numerical means were conditional, and no 3-to-75% conversion occurred.
cases.review: Actual output and keys reviewed; taxonomy and proficiency stayed distinct; local policy and teacher review remained explicit.

Matched n=3, mean change=4, d_z=2, d_av=0.4174243; paired 95% interval [-0.968275,8.968275]. Grades 91.33 and 82.00 under changed missing policy; custom final score 97 independently checked.

limits: Synthetic and generated-output validation; no classroom effectiveness evidence.
